claim: Try it with sample drawings opens a playable dodge game.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:sample-demo
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; confirm seeded game, banner, reset, and real-data exit

claim: Demo sample data is separate from a real project and is discarded when demo ends.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-isolation
sandbox: change the demo rule, enter real mode, then return through ?demo=1 and confirm the supplied dodge game is fresh

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-private
sandbox: intercept every request while loading and playing /demo; only same-origin requests may occur

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: visit /demo, wait for the service worker, set the context offline, and reload

claim: Game settings are saved in this browser.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:saved-browser
sandbox: change the demo speed, reload, and confirm the selected setting

claim: Export a game as a project file.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:project-export
sandbox: download the seeded demo project and confirm its filename and stream

claim: Import a game from a project file.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:project-import
sandbox: load a valid project file into /demo and confirm the selected game rule

claim: Use arrows, WASD, or the touch pad.
where: How to make a game, play screen
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:controls
sandbox: start /demo and exercise arrow, WASD, and on-screen direction input

claim: Workshop Pack costs US $9 once and includes four bonus ink colours.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:workshop-pack
sandbox: confirm the checkout URL and unlock from a cached valid sandbox license
